_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Tape is a coil with flat leg and mid-band sentiment; no breaker is visible, so the skilled call is score holding Complacency.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicitly forwards HOLD/Complacency; narrative gives no forward phase — partial agreement by silence on direction
next_move.confirmed_if: Momentum stays near 50, funding flat, BTC rangebound, score remains inside Complacency band
next_move.invalidated_if: Breaker up: momentum and funding lift together with CVD/ETF bid into Disbelief; Breaker down: range fails with long-short unwind and VIX/skew pinned into Anxiety
